in_sanskrit.name: Ziaul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant, Bright, Shining
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ziaul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ziaul is derived from the Arabic word 'Ziyad' which means 'increase' or 'addition'. In Hindu culture, this name is associated with the Goddess of the Night, Kali Ma, who is the embodiment of the feminine power and protects her children. The name Ziaul symbolizes the brightness and radiance of the moon and the nurturing qualities of the Goddess.
